tools.name: whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Describe the connected Freestyle account: id, username, display name, Pro access, whether new vocal takes get the Pro recording chain, enterprise organization membership, project count and the scopes this connection holds. Call this first.

tools.name: get_account_settings
tools.title: Account settings
tools.description: The full account record the app's settings use: profile fields, visibility and message policy, Pro/trial state, organization, studio region, keyboard layout, drum pad and help preferences, demographics and training consent.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.title: Update profile
tools.description: Edit the user's public profile and privacy: display_name, bio (280 chars), profile_color (#hex), avatar_style (tag|sphere|gamerpic), avatar_preset_id, profile_visibility (public|private), message_policy (requests|connections|nobody), social_links (object), artist_profile (object), hide_explicit_content, training_consent, age_years + sex. Only the fields given change.

avatar_style.description: Constraints: one of tag, sphere, gamerpic

message_policy.description: Constraints: one of requests, connections, nobody

sex.description: Constraints: one of , female, male, nonbinary, intersex, prefer_not_to_say

tools.name: check_username_availability
tools.title: Check username
tools.description: Whether a @username (3-24 letters, digits, underscores) is free.

tools.name: set_username
tools.title: Set username
tools.description: Choose the account's permanent @username. It can be set once and never changed; confirm the spelling with the user first.

tools.name: upload_avatar
tools.title: Upload profile photo
tools.description: Set the profile photo from a base64-encoded PNG, JPEG or GIF (5 MB max). The image is validated and stored the way the app's own upload is.

mime_type.description: Constraints: default "image/png"; one of image/png, image/jpeg, image/gif

tools.name: save_help_preferences
tools.title: Help preferences
tools.description: Studio help settings that follow the account: tooltips_enabled, per-context tips counters (tips object), the first-run tutorial state (tutorial object or null) or reset_tips=true to show every tip again.

tools.name: mark_ui_hint_seen
tools.title: Dismiss a UI hint
tools.description: Remember that a one-time UI hint was seen (hint ids: listen_swipe_up).

tools.name: save_drumpad_preferences
tools.title: Drum pad preferences
tools.description: Drum pad play preferences: control_source (keys|midi), local_pad_mode and layout_id (a-z0-9_- , 32 chars). Only the fields given change.

tools.name: set_daw_experience
tools.title: DAW experience answer
tools.description: Onboarding answer to 'Have you used a DAW before?': yes or no.

tools.name: set_studio_region
tools.title: Studio region
tools.description: Pin the Mozart city the user's projects open on: auto (learned home city), chi, nyc or fre.

region.description: Constraints: one of auto, chi, nyc, fre

tools.name: set_typing_keyboard_layout
tools.title: Typing keyboard layout
tools.description: The computer-keyboard piano layout: default, fl, logic or ableton.

layout.description: Constraints: one of default, fl, logic, ableton

tools.name: get_billing
tools.title: Billing overview
tools.description: The account's plan, access type, trial expiry, lifetime offer state, referral credits and recent payments (the Subscription panel).

tools.name: get_lifetime_status
tools.title: Lifetime purchase status
tools.description: Whether the account has lifetime access and the latest purchase; pass checkout_session_id after a checkout to reconcile it.

tools.name: create_lifetime_checkout
tools.title: Start lifetime checkout
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout session for the lifetime (Early Patron) offer and return its URL for the user to open. Never completes a payment. Reuse idempotency_key to get the same open session back.

tools.name: submit_bug_report
tools.title: Submit bug report
tools.description: File a bug report for the Freestyle team: message (5000 chars), optional project_id, the page url and a page_state object.

project_id.description: Constraints: max length 64

tools.name: list_connected_apps
tools.title: Connected apps
tools.description: Apps and assistants connected to the account through OAuth (this connection included): client, organization, scopes, last use.

tools.name: revoke_connected_app
tools.title: Disconnect an app
tools.description: Revoke one connected app's grant and tokens. Revoking this connection's own grant ends this conversation's access. Destructive: ask first and pass confirm=true.

confirm.description: Constraints: default false

tools.name: list_plugin_connections
tools.title: Plugin connections
tools.description: Linked paid-plugin accounts (iZotope, Antares, ...) and the adapters available. Linking is interactive and happens in the app (profile menu > Plugins).

tools.name: get_plugin_connection_status
tools.title: Plugin connection status
tools.description: Detailed status of one plugin adapter for the account (plugin_id, e.g. nectar).

tools.name: disconnect_plugin
tools.title: Disconnect plugin account
tools.description: Unlink a plugin account (connection_id from list_plugin_connections); optional mode and release_vendor_seat. Destructive: ask first and pass confirm=true.

confirm.description: Constraints: default false

tools.name: reverify_plugin
tools.title: Re-verify plugin account
tools.description: Re-verify a linked plugin account against a project the user can edit (starts an operation on the project's Mozart host).

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: get_feature_flags
tools.title: Feature flags
tools.description: The feature flags evaluated for this account (key -> enabled).

tools.name: delete_account
tools.title: Delete account
tools.description: Permanently delete the connected account: projects, recordings, settings, billing links. Irreversible. Requires confirm=true AND the account's exact username, and the app's fresh-sign-in rule: without firebase_id_token from a sign-in in the last 5 minutes the result is reauth_required with the in-app path.

confirm.description: Constraints: default false

tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List Freestyle projects
tools.description: List only projects owned by the connected Freestyle user, newest first. Optional search matches the title or artist. Use nextPage to request another bounded page.

tools.name: list_tracks
tools.title: List project tracks
tools.description: List a bounded page of tracks (audio clips) in one project owned by the connected user. Use a returned track id with the live-state and mutation tools.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: Read one owned project: title, tempo/key, backing track, lanes with mute/solo and plugin chain summary, audio clips (takes), patterns and placements, share state and the Studio URL. Live transport/loop/mixer state comes from get_pro_state.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: create_project
tools.title: Create project
tools.description: Create a new project. source.type: 'empty' (blank), 'youtube' (source.url is a YouTube link or any audio link; may return an import job to poll with get_import_status), 'catalog' (source.beatId from search_beats) or 'url'. Returns the project and its Studio URL.

source.type.description: Constraints: default "empty"; one of empty, youtube, catalog, url

tools.name: create_track
tools.title: Create an empty track
tools.description: Add an empty vocal or audio lane to a project the connected user owns. Use it right after create_project (or on any project with no tracks) so track-scoped tools (get_pro_state, execute_pro_action, mozart_ai_command, listen_to_project) have a track_id. A vocal lane gets the account's default effects chain.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

kind.description: Constraints: default "vocal"; one of vocal, audio

tools.name: rename_project
tools.title: Rename project
tools.description: Set the title of an owned project.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: duplicate_project
tools.title: Duplicate project
tools.description: Save a copy of an owned project (lanes, clips, patterns, plugin state) as a new project; optional title for the copy.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: delete_project
tools.title: Delete project
tools.description: Remove an owned project from the library (the app's delete). Destructive: ask the user first and pass confirmed_destructive=true.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: share_project
tools.title: Share project
tools.description: Return the existing share link, visibility and collaborators of an owned project.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: get_lyrics
tools.title: Get project lyrics
tools.description: Read a project's custom lyrics: every line with its timestamp (time_ms, or null when unstamped), the plain text and an LRC rendering. source is 'auto' when the project has no custom lyrics (the Studio then shows the song's auto-imported lyrics).

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: set_lyrics
tools.title: Set project lyrics
tools.description: Replace a project's custom lyrics (they override the auto-imported lyrics). Pass either content = lyrics text or the full content of a lyrics file (LRC '[mm:ss.xx] line', SRT, WebVTT or plain text; format auto-detected, or set format / filename), or lines = [{text, time_ms}] to assign each line's timestamp yourself (time_ms in ms from the song start, null = unstamped). At most 2000 lines and 512 KB.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

content.description: Lyrics text, or the text content of an .lrc/.srt/.vtt/.txt file. Constraints: max length 200000

format.description: Constraints: one of lrc, srt, vtt, txt

lines[].time_ms.description: When the line starts, in ms from the song start; null = no timestamp. Constraints: min 0; max 21600000

tools.name: set_lyric_timestamp
tools.title: Set one lyric line's timestamp
tools.description: Stamp, move or clear the timestamp of one custom lyric line (line_index from get_lyrics). Pass time_ms (absolute ms, or null to clear) or shift_ms (relative nudge, e.g. -200).

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: clear_lyrics
tools.title: Clear project lyrics
tools.description: Remove a project's custom lyrics so the Studio shows the song's auto-imported lyrics again (when it has them).

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: get_project_share
tools.title: Get project share settings
tools.description: Read who can open a project and how: visibility (private, link, public), the default role for link visitors, every collaborator with their role, the share URL and the caller's own role. Works for owners, editors and viewers of the project.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: update_project_share
tools.title: Update project visibility or default role
tools.description: Owner only. Switch a project between private (named collaborators only), link (anyone with the share URL) and public (listed on Discover), and/or set the role link visitors get (viewer or editor). Returns the updated share settings.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

visibility.description: Constraints: one of private, link, public

tools.name: invite_collaborator
tools.title: Invite a collaborator
tools.description: Owner only. Share a project with a Freestyle user by @username (or exact profile name, or user_id) as a viewer or editor; the project's default role is used when role is omitted. The person is notified in the app and sees the project in their library immediately. Inviting someone who already has access updates their role.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

user.description: An @username (the @ is optional) or a profile display name. Constraints: max length 120

user_id.description: A user id (from get_project_share, search_people_to_share or get_profile). Constraints: max length 64

tools.name: set_collaborator_role
tools.title: Change a collaborator's role
tools.description: Owner only. Make an existing collaborator a viewer or an editor. Name them by @username or user_id as listed by get_project_share.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

user.description: An @username (the @ is optional) or a profile display name. Constraints: max length 120

user_id.description: A user id (from get_project_share, search_people_to_share or get_profile). Constraints: max length 64

tools.name: remove_collaborator
tools.title: Remove a collaborator
tools.description: Owner only. Revoke a collaborator's access to a project (by @username or user_id). Destructive: ask the user first and pass confirm=true.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

user.description: An @username (the @ is optional) or a profile display name. Constraints: max length 120

user_id.description: A user id (from get_project_share, search_people_to_share or get_profile). Constraints: max length 64

confirm.description: Set true only after the user confirmed this destructive action. Constraints: default false

tools.name: search_people_to_share
tools.title: Find people to share with
tools.description: Suggest Freestyle users to invite to a project: with a query, matches on username or display name (exact handles first); without one, the owner's recent share partners and social graph. Never lists people already on the project or blocked users. Owner (or Live Session host) only.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: reset_share_link
tools.title: Reset the share link
tools.description: Owner only. Mint a new share link; everyone who joined through the old link loses access at once, named collaborators keep theirs. Destructive: ask the user first and pass confirm=true.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

confirm.description: Set true only after the user confirmed this destructive action. Constraints: default false

tools.name: get_project_credits
tools.title: Get project credits
tools.description: Read the listen player's credits for a project (artist, composition and lyrics, production and engineering, performers, producer of the beat). Available for public projects, projects the user can open, and projects released in a post the user can see.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: get_project_listen_preview
tools.title: Get the listen-page preview of a project
tools.description: Read what the shared listen player shows for a project: title, artist, cover, tempo/key, duration, the latest rendered mix and its share and listen URLs. Same admission as the player (public, link with key, owner or collaborator).

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: search_youtube
tools.title: Search YouTube
tools.description: Search YouTube for a backing track (instrumentals preferred by default). Returns video ids, titles, durations and whether the audio is already imported / in the catalog. Uses the app's shared search cache and quota.

tools.name: search_beats
tools.title: Search the beat catalog
tools.description: Browse Freestyle's curated beat catalog (only beats whose audio is already stored, so they open instantly). Filter by free-text query, genre, mood, artist, key and BPM range. Use a result's id as create_project source.beatId.

tools.name: import_youtube_backing
tools.title: Import a YouTube backing track
tools.description: Set an owned project's backing track from a YouTube link (or a Drive/Dropbox/direct audio link). Cached and catalog audio attach immediately; otherwise an import job starts and get_import_status attaches it when done.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: get_import_status
tools.title: Get import status
tools.description: Poll a backing import job (about once per second). Pass project_id to attach the finished backing to that project automatically.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 0; max length 64

tools.name: add_audio_from_url
tools.title: Add audio from a URL
tools.description: Download a public https audio file (wav/mp3/m4a/flac...) and add it to an owned project: kind 'vocal' (new vocal lane + take with the default vocal chain), 'audio' (plain audio lane, like the app's file import) or 'backing' (replaces the project's backing track). The file is validated by the same upload scanner the app uses.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

kind.description: Constraints: default "vocal"; one of vocal, audio, backing

tools.name: upload_audio
tools.title: Upload an audio file
tools.description: Add an audio file from the client's disk (base64, max 25 MB; larger files: host it and use add_audio_from_url). Targets: project_id + kind 'vocal' (new vocal lane + take with the default vocal chain), 'audio' (plain audio lane) or 'backing' (replaces the backing track); project_id + track_id (a lane or clip id) adds the take to that lane; new_project=true creates a project from the file like the Create page's audio import (Pro). The same upload scanner the app uses validates the bytes.

base64.description: The file bytes, base64-encoded (a data: URL is accepted). Max 25 MB decoded. Constraints: min length 4

filename.description: Original file name; its extension tells the validator the container. Constraints: max length 160

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 0; max length 64

track_id.description: A take / audio clip id (get_project clips, list_tracks). Constraints: min length 0; max length 64

kind.description: Constraints: default "vocal"; one of vocal, audio, backing

tools.name: import_daw_project
tools.title: Import an FL Studio or Logic project
tools.description: Create a new project from an FL Studio .flp (or zipped loop package) or a zipped Logic .logicx bundle, exactly like the app's project import (Pro). base64, max 25 MB; larger packages must be imported from the app.

base64.description: The file bytes, base64-encoded (a data: URL is accepted). Max 25 MB decoded. Constraints: min length 4

filename.description: Original file name; its extension tells the validator the container. Constraints: max length 160

tools.name: list_audio_library
tools.title: List the audio library
tools.description: Browse the account's Sound Library: uploaded and recorded audio files plus private backing tracks, with key/BPM/tags. Filter by free text, category or tag.

tools.name: list_project_saves
tools.title: List project saves
tools.description: List the named saves (version history snapshots) you made in a project, newest first, with their render status and download link when a mix was rendered.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: create_project_save
tools.title: Create a project save
tools.description: Snapshot the current project state as a named save (the app's Save). Auto-named when name is omitted.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: restore_project_save
tools.title: Restore a project save
tools.description: Roll the project back to one of your saves (lanes, clips, patterns, plugin state). Destructive: ask the user first and pass confirm=true.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

confirm.description: Set true only after the user confirmed this destructive action. Constraints: default false

tools.name: set_project_notes
tools.title: Set project notes
tools.description: Replace the project's notes (lyrics drafts, ideas; up to 20,000 characters). An empty string clears them.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: set_project_cursor
tools.title: Set the saved playhead
tools.description: Persist the playhead position (seconds) the Studio reopens the project at.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: set_project_cover
tools.title: Set project cover art
tools.description: Upload cover art (image or short video, base64, max 25 MB) for a project, switch back to a cover the project already uploaded (cover_url), or clear it (clear=true).

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: get_project_lyrics
tools.title: Get backing-track lyrics
tools.description: The lyrics the Studio shows for the project: its custom lyrics when set (source 'custom', see set_lyrics / get_lyrics), else the backing song's lyrics from public song metadata (source 'auto'; may need a retry while they are fetched the first time).

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: detect_project_key
tools.title: Detect key and scale
tools.description: Run the app's key/scale analysis on the project's backing track (default) or on a take (track_id). A take analysis is a job: poll get_key_analysis_status.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

track_id.description: A take / audio clip id (get_project clips, list_tracks). Constraints: min length 0; max length 64

tools.name: get_key_analysis_status
tools.title: Get key analysis status
tools.description: Poll a key analysis job started by detect_project_key.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: apply_track_tempo
tools.title: Time-stretch a clip
tools.description: Re-render one audio clip from source_bpm to target_bpm (the app's per-clip tempo stretch). Returns a job to poll with get_tempo_job_status; revert_track_tempo undoes it. The engine's detect_tempo action (execute_pro_action) finds a clip's BPM.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

track_id.description: A take / audio clip id (get_project clips, list_tracks). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: get_tempo_job_status
tools.title: Get tempo stretch status
tools.description: Poll a tempo stretch job started by apply_track_tempo.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

track_id.description: A take / audio clip id (get_project clips, list_tracks). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: revert_track_tempo
tools.title: Revert a tempo stretch
tools.description: Restore a clip's original audio after apply_track_tempo.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

track_id.description: A take / audio clip id (get_project clips, list_tracks). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: split_project_backing
tools.title: Split the backing into clips
tools.description: Turn the project's backing track into editable timeline clips: cut_ms splits it in two at that point, whole=true makes one full-length clip (for tempo stretching), undo=true puts the backing back.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: set_backing_muted
tools.title: Mute or unmute the backing
tools.description: Persist the backing track's mute (what the project reopens with).

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: set_track_mute_solo
tools.title: Persist a take's mute/solo
tools.description: Persist mute and solo for a take's lane (every clip on the lane follows), independent of the live engine.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

track_id.description: A take / audio clip id (get_project clips, list_tracks). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: get_backing_waveform
tools.title: Get the backing waveform
tools.description: A compact loudness envelope of the backing track (normalized peak per equal time bucket, 8-256 buckets) for finding drops, breaks and sections.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: unpack_audio_loop
tools.title: Unpack a looped clip
tools.description: Turn a pill-looped audio clip's repeats into independent clips.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

track_id.description: A take / audio clip id (get_project clips, list_tracks). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: discard_project_if_empty
tools.title: Discard an empty project
tools.description: Remove an owned project from the library only if it is still empty (the app does this when the owner leaves a blank project). Never removes content.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: list_backing_activity
tools.title: List your backing tracks
tools.description: Backing tracks from the Create page's personal tabs: 'liked', 'recent', 'for_you' (personalized, seeded daily) or 'recommendations'.

feed.description: Constraints: default "for_you"; one of for_you, liked, recent, recommendations

tools.name: list_create_categories
tools.title: List Create categories
tools.description: The Create page's instrumental categories with available/cached counts.

tools.name: browse_catalog
tools.title: Browse the instrumental catalog
tools.description: The Create page's catalog feed: popular/trending/newest instrumentals, a category (category_id from list_create_categories), the covers feed, or filters by text, genre, mood, artist, key and BPM. Includes beats whose audio is not cached yet (search_beats lists only instantly playable ones).

sort.description: Constraints: one of popular, trending, newest

tools.name: set_backing_feedback
tools.title: Hide a beat from your feed
tools.description: Mark a catalog beat as 'not for me' (signal 'dislike'; it leaves your Create feeds) or clear that mark ('neutral').

signal.description: Constraints: default "dislike"; one of dislike, neutral

tools.name: hide_catalog_beat
tools.title: Hide a beat from the catalog
tools.description: Catalog moderators only: hide a beat from Create for everyone, with a reason.

tools.name: transport_control
tools.title: Transport control
tools.description: Play, pause/stop, seek (seconds), seek_and_play, or read transport status of the live Mozart session for an owned project. Equivalent to execute_pro_action with the transport actions.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

track_id.description: A take/clip id from list_tracks or get_project (or a lane id). Optional: defaults to the project's first vocal take. Constraints: max length 64

command.description: Constraints: one of play, pause, stop, seek, seek_and_play, status

tools.name: list_plugins
tools.title: List lane plugins
tools.description: List the plugins loaded on one lane of the live session.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

track_id.description: A take/clip id from list_tracks or get_project (or a lane id). Optional: defaults to the project's first vocal take. Constraints: max length 64

lane_id.description: A lane id from get_project / get_pro_state. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: get_plugin_state
tools.title: Get plugin state
tools.description: Read one lane plugin's parameters and state (parameter indexes + values).

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

track_id.description: A take/clip id from list_tracks or get_project (or a lane id). Optional: defaults to the project's first vocal take. Constraints: max length 64

lane_id.description: A lane id from get_project / get_pro_state. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: set_plugin_parameter
tools.title: Set plugin parameter

tools.description: List an owned project's rendered exports (newest first) and named saves with a finished render, each with a one-hour signed downloadUrl.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: get_social_feed
tools.title: Get the home feed
tools.description: Newest posts the connected user can see (their own, public releases and projects shared with them), with like/bookmark state and counts. Cursor-paginated.

tools.name: discover_posts
tools.title: Browse Discover
tools.description: Ranked public releases from Discover. mode: for_you (personalised), following, pinned, new, trending or top; period daily/weekly/all applies to new and trending. Optional tag (slug) or sound_id filter. Cursor-paginated.

mode.description: Constraints: default "for_you"; one of for_you, following, pinned, new, trending, top

period.description: Constraints: default "weekly"; one of daily, weekly, all

tools.name: get_social_charts
tools.title: Get the Discover charts
tools.description: Ranked chart of public releases: type top (daily, weekly or all-time) or trending (momentum). Each post carries its rank.

period.description: Constraints: default "weekly"; one of daily, weekly, all

type.description: Constraints: default "top"; one of top, trending

tools.name: search_social
tools.title: Search people, posts, sounds and tags
tools.description: Search Freestyle's social surface by text: users (username, name, bio), posts (caption, title, artist, beat), sounds and tags. type narrows to one group and enables cursor paging within it.

type.description: Constraints: default "all"; one of all, users, posts, sounds, tags

tools.name: get_post
tools.title: Get a post
tools.description: Read one post the user can see: caption, creator, project card (title, tempo, key, cover, listen URL), counts and the user's like/bookmark state.

post_id.description: A post id from discover_posts, get_social_feed, search_social or get_profile. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: publish_post
tools.title: Publish a project as a post
tools.description: Release an owned project to Discover (visibility public), to link holders (link) or keep it private, with a caption, explicit flag, remix permission and optional cover template/colour. Re-running on the same project updates the existing post. Sets the project's share visibility to match.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

visibility.description: Constraints: default "public"; one of public, link, private

tools.name: delete_post
tools.title: Delete a post
tools.description: Take down one of the user's own posts (the project stays). Destructive: ask the user first and pass confirm=true.

post_id.description: A post id from discover_posts, get_social_feed, search_social or get_profile. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

confirm.description: Set true only after the user confirmed this destructive action. Constraints: default false

tools.name: set_post_like
tools.title: Like or unlike a post
tools.description: Like (liked=true, default) or unlike a post the user can see.

post_id.description: A post id from discover_posts, get_social_feed, search_social or get_profile. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: set_post_bookmark
tools.title: Save or unsave a post
tools.description: Bookmark (bookmarked=true, default) or remove the bookmark on a post.

post_id.description: A post id from discover_posts, get_social_feed, search_social or get_profile. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: set_post_pinned
tools.title: Feature a post on the profile
tools.description: Pin (pinned=true, default) or unpin one of the user's own public posts as the featured release on their profile; pinning replaces any previous pin.

post_id.description: A post id from discover_posts, get_social_feed, search_social or get_profile. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: mark_post_shared
tools.title: Record that a post was shared
tools.description: Count one share of a post by the user (what the app does when they copy or send its link) and return the share URL to pass along.

post_id.description: A post id from discover_posts, get_social_feed, search_social or get_profile. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: report_post
tools.title: Report a post
tools.description: Report a post for moderation with a short reason and optional details.

post_id.description: A post id from discover_posts, get_social_feed, search_social or get_profile. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: list_post_comments
tools.title: List a post's comments
tools.description: Read the visible comment thread of a post (replies carry parentId), with the user's own reaction on each.

post_id.description: A post id from discover_posts, get_social_feed, search_social or get_profile. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: add_post_comment
tools.title: Comment on a post
tools.description: Add a comment to a post, or reply in a thread with parent_comment_id. The creator is notified.

post_id.description: A post id from discover_posts, get_social_feed, search_social or get_profile. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: delete_post_comment
tools.title: Delete a comment
tools.description: Delete a comment the user wrote, or any comment on the user's own post. Destructive: ask the user first and pass confirm=true.

comment_id.description: A comment id from list_post_comments. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

confirm.description: Set true only after the user confirmed this destructive action. Constraints: default false

tools.name: set_comment_reaction
tools.title: React to a comment
tools.description: Like or dislike a comment, or clear the reaction with reaction=none.

comment_id.description: A comment id from list_post_comments. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

reaction.description: Constraints: default "like"; one of like, dislike, none

tools.name: report_comment
tools.title: Report a comment
tools.description: Report a comment for moderation with a short reason and optional details.

comment_id.description: A comment id from list_post_comments. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: list_liked_posts
tools.title: List posts the user liked
tools.description: The user's liked posts, newest like first, paged.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.title: Get a profile
tools.description: Read a user's public profile (name, bio, links, stats, relationship to the connected user, whether they accept messages) and their recent public posts. user may be an id, an @username or 'me'. Private profiles are visible to friends only; blocked users read as not found.

user.description: A user id, an @username (the @ is optional) or 'me'. Constraints: max length 120

tools.name: list_people
tools.title: List the user's followers, following, friends or friend requests
tools.description: The connected user's own people lists: followers, following, friends, or friend-requests (direction incoming by default, or outgoing).

kind.description: Constraints: default "following"; one of followers, following, friends, friend-requests

direction.description: Constraints: default "incoming"; one of incoming, outgoing

tools.name: list_profile_connections
tools.title: List another user's followers or following
tools.description: Cursor-paged followers or following list of any visible profile.

user.description: A user id, an @username (the @ is optional) or 'me'. Constraints: max length 120

kind.description: Constraints: default "followers"; one of followers, following

tools.name: set_follow
tools.title: Follow or unfollow a user
tools.description: Follow (following=true, default) or unfollow a user by id or @username.

user.description: A user id, an @username (the @ is optional) or 'me'. Constraints: max length 120

tools.name: send_friend_request
tools.title: Send a friend request
tools.description: Ask a user to be friends (by id or @username). If they already asked, this accepts and you become friends immediately.

user.description: A user id, an @username (the @ is optional) or 'me'. Constraints: max length 120

tools.name: respond_friend_request
tools.title: Accept or decline a friend request
tools.description: Accept (accept=true) or decline an incoming friend request by its requestId (from list_people kind=friend-requests or a friend_request notification).

tools.name: set_block
tools.title: Block or unblock a user
tools.description: Block a user (blocked=true, default; destructive: removes follows and friendship both ways, hides each from the other, requires confirm=true) or unblock them (blocked=false).

user.description: A user id, an @username (the @ is optional) or 'me'. Constraints: max length 120

confirm.description: Set true only after the user confirmed this destructive action. Constraints: default false

tools.name: list_blocked_users
tools.title: List blocked users
tools.description: Everyone the connected user has blocked.

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.title: List notifications
tools.description: The user's inbox (project shares, likes, comments, follows, friend requests, messages, live sessions), newest first, with the unread count and a deep link per row. unread_only=true returns only unread rows.

tools.name: mark_notifications_read
tools.title: Mark notifications read
tools.description: Mark the given notification_ids read, or all=true for every unread notification.

tools.name: delete_notification
tools.title: Delete a notification
tools.description: Remove one notification from the inbox.

tools.name: get_social_activity
tools.title: Get the user's recent social activity
tools.description: The user's own recent likes, saves, comments and shares with the posts involved.

tools.name: get_project_chat_activity
tools.title: Get project chat activity
tools.description: Per project the user can open, the latest incoming Studio chat message (id, sequence, time; no text), for an unread signal.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.title: List direct message conversations
tools.description: The user's DM threads, most recent first, with the other person, unread count and last message. folder: inbox (default), requests, sent_requests or archived. Cursor-paginated.

folder.description: Constraints: default "inbox"; one of inbox, requests, sent_requests, archived

tools.name: get_conversation_messages
tools.title: Read a conversation
tools.description: Messages in one DM thread, oldest to newest within the page. Use before (older) or after (newer, for polling) cursors from a previous call.

conversation_id.description: A conversation id from list_conversations or start_conversation. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: start_conversation
tools.title: Start a conversation
tools.description: Send a first direct message to a user (by id or @username). Opens the thread if none exists, otherwise appends to it. Refused when either person has blocked the other or the recipient's profile or message policy does not allow it.

user.description: A user id or an @username (the @ is optional). Constraints: min length 1; max length 120

body.description: The message text. Constraints: min length 1; max length 4000

client_message_id.description: Optional idempotency key: re-sending with the same key returns the original message instead of a duplicate. Generated when omitted. Constraints: max length 128; pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$

tools.name: send_message
tools.title: Send a direct message
tools.description: Send a message in an existing conversation the user is part of.

conversation_id.description: A conversation id from list_conversations or start_conversation. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

body.description: The message text. Constraints: min length 1; max length 4000

client_message_id.description: Optional idempotency key: re-sending with the same key returns the original message instead of a duplicate. Generated when omitted. Constraints: max length 128; pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$

tools.name: mark_conversation_read
tools.title: Mark a conversation read
tools.description: Mark a thread read up to through_seq (default: its latest message), clearing the unread badge and the matching notifications.

conversation_id.description: A conversation id from list_conversations or start_conversation. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: browse_marketplace
tools.title: Browse marketplace
tools.description: Search the public Freestyle marketplace for one asset type: beat kits, patterns, sound packs, single sounds, plugin presets or audio-effect presets. Optional search text, category tag and creator id. Returns bounded cards with deep links.

asset_type.description: Marketplace asset type. Constraints: one of beat_kit, pattern, sound_pack, sound, plugin, audio_effect

tools.name: marketplace_feed
tools.title: Marketplace discovery feed
tools.description: The ranked, seeded discovery feed across every public marketplace item type (the app's marketplace home). tab narrows it (all, kicks, snares, hats, 808s, toms, samples, sound_packs, beat_kits, patterns, vocal_chains, plugin_presets, audio_effects, patches); reuse seed with offset to page a stable order.

tab.description: Constraints: default "all"; 14 allowed valuesall kicks snares hats 808s toms samples sound_packs beat_kits patterns vocal_chains plugin_presets audio_effects patches

tools.name: browse_sounds
tools.title: Browse sounds
tools.description: Page playable sound rows across every inventory the user can reach (public assets, their own, shared and library-added packs): search text, a tag and a category, cursor-paged. Patterns are excluded.

tools.name: list_my_library_assets
tools.title: List my library
tools.description: The user's Sound Library for one asset type: assets they made, added from the marketplace, were invited to, plus the built-in packs. Paged: pass nextCursor back as cursor until it is null; total is the full count.

asset_type.description: Marketplace asset type. Constraints: one of beat_kit, pattern, sound_pack, sound, plugin, audio_effect

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

tools.name: list_pattern_library
tools.title: List pattern library
tools.description: The unified Pattern Library (patterns + sound packs). scope='library' lists what the user owns or added; scope='marketplace' lists public entries.

scope.description: Constraints: default "library"; one of library, marketplace

tools.name: get_marketplace_asset
tools.title: Get marketplace asset
tools.description: One marketplace asset with its sharing state and capabilities. include_payload=true also returns the full portable payload (pattern events, preset state or beat-kit pads), which can be large.

asset_type.description: Marketplace asset type. Constraints: one of beat_kit, pattern, sound_pack, sound, plugin, audio_effect

asset_id.description: A marketplace asset id (from browse_marketplace / marketplace_feed). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: list_sound_pack_items
tools.title: List sound pack items
tools.description: Cursor-page the sounds inside a sound pack or pattern-library asset the user can open, with optional search, tag and category filters.

asset_id.description: A marketplace asset id (from browse_marketplace / marketplace_feed). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: list_preset_pack_items
tools.title: List preset pack items
tools.description: Browse the items of a built-in preset pack (offset-paged); falls back to the sound pack listing for migrated packs.

asset_id.description: A marketplace asset id (from browse_marketplace / marketplace_feed). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: save_marketplace_asset
tools.title: Save marketplace asset
tools.description: Save a new private asset from a portable payload: a pattern, sound, sound pack, plugin preset or audio-effect preset (beat kits use publish_drum_kit). Pro only. The payload shape is the one get_marketplace_asset(include_payload=true) returns for the same asset type.

asset_type.description: Constraints: one of pattern, sound, sound_pack, plugin, audio_effect

tools.name: update_marketplace_asset
tools.title: Update marketplace asset
tools.description: Rename or re-describe an asset the user owns, or change its categories, tags or library category. A published beat kit's sounds and pricing cannot change.

asset_type.description: Marketplace asset type. Constraints: one of beat_kit, pattern, sound_pack, sound, plugin, audio_effect

asset_id.description: A marketplace asset id (from browse_marketplace / marketplace_feed). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: delete_marketplace_asset
tools.title: Delete marketplace asset
tools.description: Delete an asset the user owns (the app's soft delete; people who added it lose it). Destructive: ask the user first and pass confirm=true.

asset_type.description: Marketplace asset type. Constraints: one of beat_kit, pattern, sound_pack, sound, plugin, audio_effect

asset_id.description: A marketplace asset id (from browse_marketplace / marketplace_feed). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

confirm.description: Constraints: default false

tools.name: add_marketplace_asset_to_library
tools.title: Add to my library
tools.description: Add a public marketplace asset to the user's Sound Library (a reference, not a copy). A beat kit becomes a private drum kit they can load into projects. Pro only.

asset_type.description: Marketplace asset type. Constraints: one of beat_kit, pattern, sound_pack, sound, plugin, audio_effect

asset_id.description: A marketplace asset id (from browse_marketplace / marketplace_feed). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: like_marketplace_asset
tools.title: Like a beat kit
tools.description: Heart (liked=true) or un-heart (liked=false) a public beat kit.

asset_id.description: A marketplace asset id (from browse_marketplace / marketplace_feed). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: get_marketplace_asset_share
tools.title: Get asset sharing
tools.description: Visibility (private, link, public) and the people an asset is shared with.

asset_type.description: Marketplace asset type. Constraints: one of beat_kit, pattern, sound_pack, sound, plugin, audio_effect

asset_id.description: A marketplace asset id (from browse_marketplace / marketplace_feed). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: update_marketplace_asset_share
tools.title: Update asset sharing
tools.description: Change an owned asset's visibility (private, link or public = published to the marketplace), invite a person by @username or email (add_user) or remove one (remove_user_id). Beat kits publish only through publish_drum_kit. Pro only.

asset_type.description: Marketplace asset type. Constraints: one of beat_kit, pattern, sound_pack, sound, plugin, audio_effect

asset_id.description: A marketplace asset id (from browse_marketplace / marketplace_feed). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

visibility.description: Constraints: one of private, link, public

tools.name: apply_marketplace_pattern
tools.title: Apply pattern to project
tools.description: Apply a marketplace pattern to a project the user can edit: mode 'pattern' copies the events, 'sounds' only the samples, 'pattern_and_sounds' both (default). channel_ids limits it to some channels; target_pattern_id picks an existing pattern instead of creating one. Pro only.

asset_id.description: A marketplace asset id (from browse_marketplace / marketplace_feed). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

mode.description: Constraints: default "pattern_and_sounds"; one of pattern, sounds, pattern_and_sounds

tools.title: Preview pattern in project

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: record_marketplace_play
tools.title: Record a marketplace play
tools.description: Count one play of a marketplace item (feeds the trending ranking). Call it when the user listened to an item you surfaced.

item_type.description: Constraints: default "sound"; one of sound, sound_pack, beat_kit, pattern, vocal_chain, plugin, audio_effect, patch

tools.name: materialize_sound_pack_item
tools.title: Add sound to project
tools.description: Add one sound-pack item (from list_sound_pack_items / browse_sounds) to a project the user can edit, as a sample the drum pad and pattern builder can use. Pro only.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: get_sound_usage
tools.title: Sound usage
tools.description: Who used a sound or beat: the top and most recent public posts built on it (ids, titles, usernames).

sound_id.description: A backing/sound id or source key (e.g. youtube:<id>). Constraints: min length 1; max length 200

tools.name: list_drum_kits
tools.title: List drum kits
tools.description: The user's saved drum kits plus the default kits offered for a project (project_id adds the project's cover kit when it has one). Pro only.

project_id.description: Constraints: max length 64

tools.name: save_drum_kit
tools.title: Save drum kit
tools.description: Save a private drum kit from a pad snapshot ({version, pads: [{audioFileId, name, volume, rootPitch, samplePlaybackMode, midiNote, ...}]}) using sounds the user already owns or added. Pro only.

tools.name: publish_drum_kit
tools.title: Publish drum kit
tools.description: Publish one of the user's saved kits to the marketplace, free and public. The user must confirm they may distribute the sounds (rights_confirmed=true). Pro only.

tools.name: prepare_drum_kit
tools.title: Load drum kit into project
tools.description: Load a saved (or added) drum kit's sounds into a project the user can edit so its pads are playable there. Pro only.

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.title: List project templates

tools.name: create_project_from_template
tools.title: Create project from template
tools.description: Create a new project from a template id (list_project_templates). Cover templates clone the published cover; effect templates make an empty project with the native chain ready (Pro only).

tools.name: get_splice_status
tools.title: Splice connection status
tools.description: Whether the user's Splice account is linked, its scopes and expiry. Linking itself is a browser OAuth flow (connect_splice returns the URL).

tools.title: Connect Splice
tools.description: Start linking the user's Splice account: returns an authorization URL the user must open in a browser (rate limited). Finish with get_splice_status.

tools.name: disconnect_splice
tools.title: Disconnect Splice
tools.description: Unlink the user's Splice account and revoke the stored tokens. Destructive: ask first and pass confirm=true.

tools.name: search_splice_sounds
tools.title: Search Splice
tools.description: Search Splice Sounds with the user's linked account: text plus optional bpm, key and genre. Needs a connected Splice account.

tools.name: preview_splice_sound
tools.title: Preview Splice sound
tools.description: A preview URL for one Splice sound (no credit spent, nothing imported).

tools.name: download_splice_sound
tools.title: Download Splice sound

project_id.description: Constraints: max length 64

confirm.description: Constraints: default false

tools.name: get_current_live_session
tools.title: Current live session
tools.description: The live session the user is in right now (members, queue, current project, role) with the room link, or active=false. Audio and voice chat exist only in the browser room.

tools.name: get_live_session
tools.title: Get live session
tools.description: One live session the user belongs to (or belonged to, once ended): status, host, members, projects made inside it, the beat queue and pending requests.

session_id.description: A live session id (from get_current_live_session / start_live_session). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: get_live_queue_status
tools.title: My place in live queues
tools.description: Where the user stands in every active Freestyle LIVE queue: position, state (queued, next, current) and the room link. Membership is not required.

tools.name: get_live_queue_readiness
tools.title: Live queue readiness
tools.description: Per queue row: media import progress and whether it is ready to play.

session_id.description: A live session id (from get_current_live_session / start_live_session). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: get_recent_live_session
tools.title: Recent live session recap
tools.description: The user's most recently ended session (within the recap window): when and why it ended, the projects they can still open and whether it can be resumed.

tools.name: start_live_session
tools.title: Start live session
tools.description: Open a live session (an Endless / group room) hosted by the user, optionally inviting people by user id or @username and allowing link access. Returns the room link and share link. Idempotent per client_create_id.

visibility.description: Constraints: default "private"; one of private, link

client_create_id.description: Reuse to make the call idempotent (4-64 chars, [A-Za-z0-9_-]). Constraints: max length 64

tools.name: invite_to_live_session
tools.title: Add live session member
tools.description: Host only: add a person (user id or @username) to a live session. They get the room link grant and a notification. Blocked users and full rooms are refused.

session_id.description: A live session id (from get_current_live_session / start_live_session). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

user.description: A user id or @username. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: remove_live_session_member
tools.title: Remove live session member
tools.description: Host only: remove a member from a live session (their project grants stay). Destructive: ask first and pass confirm=true.

session_id.description: A live session id (from get_current_live_session / start_live_session). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

user.description: A user id or @username. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

confirm.description: Constraints: default false

tools.name: leave_live_session
tools.title: Leave live session

session_id.description: A live session id (from get_current_live_session / start_live_session). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: end_live_session
tools.title: End live session

session_id.description: A live session id (from get_current_live_session / start_live_session). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

confirm.description: Constraints: default false

tools.name: resume_live_session
tools.title: Resume live session

session_id.description: A live session id (from get_current_live_session / start_live_session). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

session_id.description: A live session id (from get_current_live_session / start_live_session). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

command.description: Constraints: one of remove, reorder, jump, approve_request, dismiss_request, retry_import

tools.name: queue_project_in_live_session

session_id.description: A live session id (from get_current_live_session / start_live_session). Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

project_id.description: A project id returned by list_projects / create_project. Constraints: min length 1; max length 64

tools.name: apply_audio_template
tools.title: Apply a Freestyle audio template
tools.description: Use this when the user attaches one audio file and asks Mozart to apply a Freestyle template, such as fade out. Creates an owned Stage project, renders the processed audio, and returns an inline player plus expiring share and direct-download links. Fade, Delay, and Reverb accept optional parameters. Map 'fade in from beginning to end' to fade-in with fade_duration_mode=full_clip. Map '50% wet reverb' to reverb with reverb_mix_pct=50. If status is not complete, call get_audio_template_render with renderId until it is complete. For a follow-up adjustment, preserve renderId and revision and call revise_audio_template_render; never guess a render ID.

template_id.description: The exact Freestyle template to apply. Use fade-out for a fade-out request. Constraints: 17 allowed valuesamplify change-pitch clip-distortion compressor delay distortion echo fade-in fade-out limiter normalize phaser reverb reverse tremolo vocoder wah-wah

parameters.fade_duration_sec.description: Explicit fade length. For a vague longer/shorter follow-up, choose a sensible value relative to the prior result's parameters. Constraints: min 0.05; max 30

parameters.fade_duration_mode.description: Use full_clip for requests such as 'fade in from beginning to end' or 'fade across the whole file'. Do not also send fade_duration_sec. Constraints: one of seconds, full_clip

parameters.delay_time_ms.description: Delay time in milliseconds. Constraints: min 10; max 2000

parameters.reverb_mix_pct.description: Wet/dry reverb mix. For '50% wet reverb', send 50. Constraints: min 0; max 100

parameters.effort.description: Constraints: one of low, medium, high, max

parameters.crossfade_duration_sec.description: Explicit overlap length. For a vague longer/shorter follow-up, choose a sensible value relative to the prior result's parameters. Constraints: min 0.05; max 30

tools.name: apply_voice_model_to_audio
tools.title: Apply a Freestyle voice model
tools.description: Use this when the user attaches one vocal file and asks for an artist voice or RVC voice conversion. For 'Travis Scott voice', pass voice_query='Travis Scott' and omit effort. The server resolves an eligible live catalog model; never invent or pass a model ID or path. Effort defaults to low. Set medium, high, or max only when the user explicitly asks for that effort. Creates an editable owned Stage project and returns the same inline player and links. Poll get_audio_template_render until complete and preserve renderId and revision for follow-ups.

tools.name: get_clip_waveform
tools.title: Get clip waveform
tools.description: Per-channel waveform of one clip's source audio over a frame range, for drawing and sample-level zoom. Returns sample_rate, channel_count, frame_count, the clip's placement (start_ms, audio_offset_frames, duration_frames, gain), a revision that changes when the source audio changes, and channels[{min,max,rms}] with bucket_count buckets. Values are raw signed PCM in [-1,1], pre clip-gain and pre effects. Bucket b covers source frames [start + floor(b*span/n), start + floor((b+1)*span/n)); a range shorter than buckets returns one frame per bucket. clip_id is a durable clip id from get_project (or 'backing'). The clip must be loaded in the live session.

tools.name: edit_time_range
tools.title: Edit a time range
tools.description: Audacity-style time-range edit across lanes, applied as ONE atomic engine batch (all or nothing; 409 conflict if any clip changed since it was read). operation: 'split' (cut clips at start_ms and end_ms), 'delete' (remove [start_ms, end_ms); ripple=true closes the gap like Audacity Delete, ripple=false leaves silence like Split Delete), 'trim_to_selection' (keep only the selected part). lane_ids are lane ids from get_project. Boundaries are whole milliseconds. Returns the planned ops, the resulting clips (clips_after, with new clip ids) and undo.inverse_ops: pass them to apply_clip_batch to undo the whole edit in one step. idempotency_key makes a retry safe (new clip ids are derived from it). dry_run=true returns the plan only.

tools.name: apply_clip_batch
tools.title: Apply an atomic clip batch
tools.description: Apply up to 256 clip operations in ONE database transaction, then mirror them in the live engine. op: 'update' (set start_ms/duration_sec/audio_offset_sec), 'insert' (new same-lane clip id copied from source_id: same audio, own window), 'remove' (soft-delete), 'restore' (un-delete with timing; source_id = a live clip of the same audio so the engine can play it). expected {start_ms, duration_sec, audio_offset_sec} on an op must match the clip or nothing is applied (409). Use it with edit_time_range's undo.inverse_ops for a one-step undo. Returns replay=true when the same insert ids were already committed, and engine_reload_required when the live session could not mirror an op.
